question: Could you provide, for the United States, France, China, Italy, Spain, Germany, and Iran, the total number of confirmed COVID-19 cases as of April 20, 2020, along with the number of cases per 100,000 people based on their total 2020 populations calculated by summing all relevant population entries from the World Bank data
sql:
SELECT 
    c.country AS country,
    c.total_confirmed,
    p.population_2020,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(c.total_confirmed * 100000, p.population_2020) AS cases_per_100k
FROM (
    SELECT 'United States' AS country, SUM(confirmed) as total_confirmed 
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary` 
    WHERE date = '2020-04-20' AND country_region = 'US'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'France', SUM(confirmed) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary` WHERE date = '2020-04-20' AND country_region = 'France'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'China', SUM(confirmed) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary` WHERE date = '2020-04-20' AND country_region = 'China'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Italy', SUM(confirmed) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary` WHERE date = '2020-04-20' AND country_region = 'Italy'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Spain', SUM(confirmed) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary` WHERE date = '2020-04-20' AND country_region = 'Spain'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Germany', SUM(confirmed) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary` WHERE date = '2020-04-20' AND country_region = 'Germany'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Iran', SUM(confirmed) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary` WHERE date = '2020-04-20' AND country_region = 'Iran'
) c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 'USA' AS country_code, value AS population_2020 FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` WHERE indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND country_code = 'USA' AND year = 2020
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'FRA', value FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` WHERE indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND country_code = 'FRA' AND year = 2020
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CHN', value FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` WHERE indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND country_code = 'CHN' AND year = 2020
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'ITA', value FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` WHERE indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND country_code = 'ITA' AND year = 2020
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'ESP', value FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` WHERE indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND country_code = 'ESP' AND year = 2020
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'DEU', value FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` WHERE indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND country_code = 'DEU' AND year = 2020
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'IRN', value FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` WHERE indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND country_code = 'IRN' AND year = 2020
) p ON (CASE WHEN c.country = 'United States' THEN 'USA' ELSE c.country END) = p.country_code
ORDER BY c.country
